hero.title: A single, living record of every authority engagement on the Safari Park Project.
hero.lede: Sixteen statutory authorities. Twenty-three sub-divisions. Every communication, meeting, and document tracked, timestamped, and visible to the people who need it — in one place, in real time.

footer.title: Ready when you are.
footer.body: Sign in with the email your administrator provisioned. If you do not have an account yet, ask the Safari Park Project administrator at ECG.
